title: OpenPayd Adds Three Hires Ahead of its Next Phase of Infrastructure Growth
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – London, United Kingdom, November 25th, 2026] Appointments add global banking and digital asset expertise following OpenPayd’s 44% year-on-year Q2 revenue growth OpenPayd, a leading provider of financial infrastructure, has appointed three senior hires with experience across global banking and digital assets to grow its stablecoin payments business and strengthen the banking team […]
